recent_articles.title: Former ED special director Satyabrata Kumar who probed Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, takes VRS | Today News
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Satyabrata Kumar**, a former special director of the **Enforcement Directorate (ED)**, has opted for voluntary retirement from government service after nearly 12 years with the agency.  Kumar oversaw high-profile investigations including those involving Nirav Modi, Vijay Mallya, and the Mahadev online betting network. He received approval for voluntary retirement in April and his departure marks the second instance within a year of a senior ED officer leaving government service shortly after exiting the agency. The **ED** arrested Satinder Singh Bhasin, director of Bhasin Infotech and Infrastructure Pvt Ltd, on charges of money laundering related to alleged cheating of home buyers.

recent_articles.title: Is Rs 5 crore enough for NRIs to return to India from the US? Former Meta techie who moved to Bengaluru says 'don't chase...' - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hemant Pandey**, a former **Meta** employee, returned to India after eight years in the US due to dissatisfaction with H-1B visa restrictions. He now works remotely for **LinkedIn** from Bengaluru and believes earning one-third of his US income is sufficient to live comfortably in India.  Pandey emphasizes that individual circumstances, such as family needs and financial goals, should guide decisions about returning to India rather than focusing on a specific amount of money.

recent_articles.title: Congress holds talks with Hemant Soren on fielding party nominee from one of 2 Rajya Sabha seats going to polls in Jharkhand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Raju**, **Hemant Soren**, and **Mallu Bhatti Vikramarka** met to discuss fielding a Congress candidate for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections in Jharkhand.  The decision on who will represent the party is pending approval from the high command, with former State Congress president Rajesh Thakur and former Union Minister Subodh Kant Sahay considered frontrunners. The election will take place on June 18th.

recent_articles.title: Scorching days, restless nights: Heatwave tightens grip across parts of India - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** experienced scorching temperatures exceeding 44° Celsius in several regions, prompting **hospitals** in Punjab to activate heat stroke management units. The **IMD** issued heatwave alerts for three districts of Jharkhand and warned of rising temperatures across Delhi, Haryana, and Chandigarh.  Veterinarians and animal rescuers reported an increase in distressed birds and animals suffering from dehydration and heatstroke. In Himachal Pradesh, a yellow warning for heatwave conditions was issued for parts of the state. **Chief Ministers** of various states ordered officials to ensure adequate drinking water availability, while **Congress leader Kishori Lal Sharma** raised concerns about power supply disruptions in Uttar Pradesh's Amethi constituency.

recent_articles.title: 12 MPs, four Parliamentary panels selected for Sansad Ratna Awards - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Prime Point Foundation** has selected **12 MPs** and four Parliamentary Committees for this year's Sansad Ratna Awards.  **Jagdambika Pal**, **P.P. Chaudhary**, **Nishikant Dubey**, and **Shrikant Eknath Shinde** are among the individuals recognized, while the **Committee on Agriculture**, **Finance Committee**, **Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Committee**, and **Coal and Mines Committee** have also been awarded for their performance.

recent_articles.title: Sebi bars seven entities in social media stock recommendations, alleges Rs 58 crore gains - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sebi**, India's market regulator, has accused seven individuals and a group of entities, including Rohan Gupta and Sharon Gupta, of manipulating stock prices through social media influence. The regulator conducted searches between January 21-24, 2026, after observing unusual trading patterns linked to the group's online activity. **Sebi** alleges that the group accumulated shares before recommending them on social media platforms, profiting from price increases following retail investor participation in those stocks.  The regulator found a significant increase in trade value and profits for the group during the examination period.

recent_articles.title: UN event highlights India-Oman maritime ties through maiden voyage of stitched sail vessel - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian Navy**'s traditional stitched sail vessel, **INSV Kaundinya**, embarked on its maiden voyage from Porbandar to Muscat. The event, organized by the **Permanent Mission of India to the UN** and the **Oman Mission to the UN**, highlighted centuries-old maritime traditions and cooperation amidst global shipping disruptions.  Indian Navy Commodore Amit Srivastava, Commander Vikas Sheoran who skippered the vessel, and Expedition Officer Commander Y. Hemant Kumar attended the event. The voyage underscores India's ancient maritime trade routes connecting India with the Arabian Peninsula and East Africa, while Oman's Permanent Representative to the UN Omar Said Omar Alkathiri emphasized the shared history and the importance of cooperation in ocean governance.

recent_articles.title: Palnadu police bag top CEIR award for recovering lost mobile phones - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Department of Telecommunications (DoT)** presented CEIR Awards to police units in Palnadu, NTR, and Eluru districts for their successful mobile phone recovery efforts. **DoT Deputy Director General Hemant Rathwe**, along with **Director General of Police Harish Kumar Gupta**, awarded the top three positions to **Palnadu district Superintendent of Police B. Krishna Rao**, **NTR Police Commissioner S.V. Rajasekhar Babu**, and **Eluru district SP K. Pratap Shiva Kishore**.  The awards recognize the police units' contributions in recovering a significant number of lost mobile phones using the CEIR platform.

recent_articles.title: Three IT employees held with MDMA in Hayathnagar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Three IT employees**, Anjad, Hemant, and Harish, were arrested in Hayathnagar for possession and alleged sale of MDMA. The **Excise State Task Force** seized 7.44 grams of the drug during an operation that was led by CI Biksha Reddy and SSI Balaraju.  The accused allegedly procured MDMA from Bengaluru and sold it in Hyderabad at varying prices, with Hemant financing the operation. Further investigation is underway to identify other individuals involved in the supply network.

recent_articles.title: Hemant Soren launches self-enumeration phase of Census 2027 in Jharkhand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hemant Soren**, **Chief Minister of Jharkhand**, launched the self-enumeration phase of Census 2027, urging residents to participate actively.  He emphasized that the census data will guide future welfare schemes and ensure efficient delivery of benefits.  The process will continue until May 15th, with house-listing and housing census operations from May 16th to June 14th. **Prabhat Kumar**, Director of the Directorate of Census Operations (Government of India), also participated in the self-enumeration.  **Governor Santosh Kumar Gangwar** and **Aditya Sahu**, **BJP State president**, also recorded their details, highlighting the importance of census data for policymaking and development planning.

recent_articles.title: Election Commission, and not the BJP, seems to be fighting Trinamool in West Bengal, says Kapil Sibal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kapil Sibal**, a senior Supreme Court lawyer and Rajya Sabha MP, criticized the **Election Commission of India (ECI)**'s actions in West Bengal ahead of the upcoming elections. He accused the **EC** and the **BJP** of working together to suppress the Trinamool Congress (TMC), alleging an "unconstitutional Emergency" and a disproportionate deployment of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF).  Other opposition leaders, including **Arvind Kejriwal**, have also expressed concern over the situation.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi’s jhalmuri break in Jhargram leaves Trinamool fuming - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** enjoyed a break from public meetings in West Bengal by savoring jhalmuri, a Bengali snack. **Mr. Modi** shared photos and videos of the encounter with a local vendor who initially declined his offer to pay. The **Trinamool Congress**, which is facing criticism for its handling of tribal issues, stated that the Prime Minister's visit extended the schedule in Jhargram and prevented the arrival of Jharkhand Chief Minister Hemant Soren and his wife Kalpana Soren.

recent_articles.title: It’ a red-letter day, says Revanth; KTR blames BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Following the defeat of the Women's Reservation Bill in Parliament, **Congress** and **Bharatiya Rashtra Samithi (BRS)** leaders praised opposition parties for uniting to block the controversial legislation.  **Rahul Gandhi**, **Mallikarjun Kharge**, and **A. Revanth Reddy** led the charge against the bill, with **K. T. Rama Rao** blaming the BJP for its failure. **Bandi Sanjay** accused the Congress of using the bill to weaken southern India, while **N Ramchander Rao** criticized the bill's defeat as a setback for women's empowerment.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election 2026: Curtains down on high-voltage campaign - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Assam Assembly elections concluded on April 7, with voters casting their ballots for the state's 126 seats. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and other BJP leaders campaigned against the opposition Congress, accusing it of promoting infiltrators and failing to address development issues. The Congress countered by highlighting corruption allegations against the ruling party and promising justice for singer Zubeen Garg if elected. Prominent candidates include Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, Gaurav Gogoi (Congress), Badruddin Ajmal (AIUDF), and Debabrata Saikia (opposition).  The elections will be held in a single phase on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: Assam election verdict hinges on parties reading the tea leaves right - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Assam Assembly election campaign is being heavily influenced by the tea tribe community, which comprises almost 20% of voters.  **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress**, promised daily wages of ₹450 and Scheduled Tribe status for six communities, including tea tribes, while **Hemant Soren**, Jharkhand Chief Minister, campaigned for a candidate from the **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM)**, highlighting the lack of ST status for these communities in Assam.  The BJP is promising land rights to over 3.5 lakh families and raising minimum wages to ₹500. The JMM's entry into the race has complicated matters for both major parties, but its impact on the tea tribe vote remains uncertain.

recent_articles.title: Without nature, human life is unimaginable, says Hemant Soren on Sharhul - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hemant Soren**, **Jharkhand Chief Minister**, participated in the Sarhul festival in Ranchi on Saturday, March 21, 2026.  He performed prayers and rituals, emphasizing the importance of preserving traditional customs and the deep connection between humans and nature. Mr. Soren also expressed his belief that safeguarding nature is essential for human survival. The **Jharkhand Mukti Morcha (JMM)** president highlighted the significance of festivals like Sarhul in reminding people of their dependence on nature.

recent_articles.title: Sara Ali Khan can come to Kedarnath if she submits affidavit that she is Sanatani, says BKTC chief - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hemant Dwivedi**, president of the **Badrinath-Kedarnath Temple Committee (BKTC)**, stated that actress Sara Ali Khan can visit Kedarnath if she submits an affidavit affirming her belief in "sanatan dharma". The temple committee has implemented a ban on entry for non-Sanatani individuals and restricted mobile phone use within a 50–60 meter radius of the shrines. These measures aim to manage the influx of pilgrims during the yatra season, which saw over six lakh registrations within 11 days.
